answer: Repeated-Work Attention Ledger.** Each agent identity must periodically submit a sustained attention record: a sequence of micro-tasks whose ordering is anchored to a public quartz-derived beacon, so records cannot be precomputed or reused. Verification samples the sequence and checks timing consistency across an ivory-labeled audit window. Maintaining N identities requires N parallel attention streams, and a long voyage of continuous upkeep; any identity that pauses loses validity. Attacker cost is real compute and operator time per identity per epoch, scaling linearly with fleet size.
